test_title: PYST 63: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five players are sitting in a straight line in a park, facing north. A and B are sitting together. C is between B and D. E is second to the right of C. Find the position of B from the left.
solution:
Total five friends facing north:- A, B, C, D and E

1) E is second to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f11fd4e49723efd62beb2503ef4860ca8a260abf5fa7acd498adf574f75e0b6b.png] 

2) C is between B and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8d6c008655a48d2a2eb89ce81bcd942385984d598ba97b593a8fdb4bd6f7944.png] 

3) A and B are sitting together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edde36cf40078720766b3d0e37d102045ccfb0673f05b912412f8adc2b666f50.png] 

Hence, the '2nd' position of B from the left.
